_doc: Convert File with an XML source and KeepOriginalData, pasted into FileMaker Pro 26.0.3 and copied back; XC-DIALOG was authored in FileMaker's Specify XML and XSL Options dialog. `pasted` is what was pasted (null for the dialog case), `fm` is FileMaker's copy-out, `fmLine` FileMaker's Script Workspace line. FileMaker keeps the step-level <Calculation> as the XML calculation: XC-COPYONLY gains <XMLCalc> from it, XC-COPYWINS writes the copy's value to both, XC-FIELDONLY-DROPPED (only <XMLCalc>, no copy) loses the XML calculation. Cases marked pastedDiffers hold a pasted shape FileMaker never writes (an <XMLCalc> with no copy, or a copy that differs from it); the converter reads the <XMLCalc> there, so only FileMaker's copy-out is expected to round-trip.

_docLines: lineCases: more Convert File steps pasted into FileMaker Pro 26.0.3 and copied back (`fm`), with FileMaker's Script Workspace line (`fmLine`), for the sources FileMaker draws in the path slot: every XML / XSL source pairing, a file path list (line breaks drawn as spaces), the XSL file path cut to its file name (after the last '/', else after the first ':'), an empty source left out, and calculations with a semicolon and a line break. Cases marked fmAddsEmptySource were pasted without the element of the source they leave empty; FileMaker wrote an empty one back, which the converter does not write (it pastes as the same step), so the round-trip tests skip them.
